title: wolfHSM C_ImportKey: import DER private key to server
description:
Implement key import for wolfHSM slots: accept a DER-encoded private key via C_CreateObject and store it on the server, receiving a whKeyId back.

What needs to be done:
- In C_CreateObject, add a wolfHSM path for CKO_PRIVATE_KEY when the session slot is WP11_PROTO_WOLFHSM
- Parse the DER from CKA_VALUE attribute (for secret keys) or from CKA_EC_PARAMS+CKA_VALUE (for EC) or CKA_MODULUS+CKA_PRIVATE_EXPONENT etc. (for RSA) to reconstruct the key
- Call wh_Client_KeyImport (or equivalent) to push the DER to the server; server returns a whKeyId
- Allocate wp11_wolfhsm_key_priv_t and create a g_keys[] entry with the returned key_id
- Return the object handle to the caller

Design decisions:
- CKA_TOKEN=TRUE: key is stored persistently on server NVM; persists across C_Finalize
- CKA_TOKEN=FALSE: key is stored in server RAM only; evicted at C_Logout (use wh_Client_KeyEvict in the C_Logout or C_DestroyObject path)
- Private key material is not returned by C_GetAttributeValue (CKA_EXTRACTABLE=FALSE by default for imported keys)

This is lower priority than key discovery and generation because most wolfHSM deployments use server-side provisioning tools rather than PKCS#11 import.
